definitions.explanation: A restaurant that serves traditional Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {和食店|わしょくてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}する→食事する：01837_shokujisuru⟧。
examples.english: To dine at a Japanese restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{和食店|わしょくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new Japanese restaurant opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{和食店|わしょくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧おり、⟦{日本食|にほんしょく}→日本食：12955_nihonshoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うかがえる→うかがう：01273_ukagau⟧。
examples.english: The number of Japanese restaurants is increasing overseas as well, showing the high popularity of Japanese food.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese cuisine) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop, restaurant). ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ was recognized as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2013, and the term {和食店|わしょくてん} has become increasingly common both in Japan and abroad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和食店|わしょくてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat at a Japanese restaurant
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{和食店|わしょくてん}: upscale Japanese restaurant
- {和食店|わしょくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a Japanese restaurant
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和食店|わしょくてん}: popular Japanese restaurant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}{店|てん}→料理店：25626_ryouriten⟧: Japanese cuisine restaurant — more formal, essentially synonymous
- ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧: traditional Japanese restaurant — upscale establishment with private rooms and full-course meals
- ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧: izakaya; Japanese pub — a more casual drinking establishment that also serves food
- {洋食店|ようしょくてん}: Western-style restaurant — serving Western-influenced Japanese cuisine
